note: Claims T6 Detroit (claim_en tiếng Anh; ghi chú tiếng Việt). D01–D65: tác tử con tra nguồn, trích nguyên văn kiểm tự động (chuỗi con của văn bản tách, chuẩn hoá NFKC/khoảng trắng; 65/65 + 16/16 trích phụ đạt); tệp gốc + SHA ngoài git. P01–P17: phiên chính tự tính từ tệp có SHA. Status: XÁC MINH | XÁC MINH (nguồn phụ) | MÂU THUẪN | CHỜ XÁC MINH GỐC.

claims.claim_en: In 1910 Ford moved its operations to the new Highland Park Plant.
claims.nguon: NPS – NRHP/NHL nomination, Highland Park Ford Plant (73000961)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: In 1910 the Ford Motor Company moved its operations to the new Highland Park Plant
claims.ghi_chu: Nhà máy nằm ở thành phố Highland Park (lọt trong Detroit), không phải trong ranh giới Detroit.

claims.claim_en: In 1913 Ford and his engineers developed the continuously moving assembly line at Highland Park, cutting assembly time of a car from 728 to 93 minutes.
claims.nguon: NPS – NRHP/NHL nomination, Highland Park Ford Plant (73000961)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: 1913 Ford and his engineers developed the continuously moving assembly line
claims.ghi_chu: Số phút: 'from 728 minutes to 93 minutes' cùng đoạn. Ngày cụ thể: hồ sơ Rouge ghi 'By December 1' (1913) dây chuyền lắp ráp cuối chạy liên tục; Wikipedia ghi 07/10/1913 – không dùng ngày cụ thể nếu không cần.

claims.claim_en: Ford announced the 'Five Dollar Day' on January 5, 1914.
claims.nguon: NPS – NRHP/NHL nomination, Ford River Rouge Complex (78001516)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: His announcement of the "Five Dollar Day" on January 5, 1914, made him a worldwide figure
claims.ghi_chu: Hồ sơ Highland Park có cùng câu nhưng OCR lỗi ('Day 11'). Ngày công bố, không phải ngày áp dụng (12/01/1914 – chưa kiểm).

claims.claim_en: The Highland Park plant was designed for the most part by industrial architect Albert Kahn and was the scene of mass-production advances from 1910 to 1927.
claims.nguon: NPS – NRHP/NHL nomination, Highland Park Ford Plant (73000961)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Designed for the most part by noted industrial architect Albert Kahn, the plant from 1910 to 1927 was the scene of numerous advances in the development of mass production techniques.

claims.claim_en: Ford's River Rouge complex lies west of Detroit in the city of Dearborn; it was designed largely by Albert Kahn and built mostly between 1917 and 1927.
claims.nguon: NPS – NRHP/NHL nomination, Ford River Rouge Complex (78001516)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: is situated west of Detroit in the city of Dearborn. Designed largely by noted industrial architect Albert Kahn and constructed for the most part between 1917 and 1927
claims.ghi_chu: Quan trọng cho câu chuyện: nhà máy lớn nhất của Ford không nằm trong thành phố Detroit.

claims.claim_en: Ford's final assembly line was shifted from Highland Park to the Rouge in 1927, the year Model A manufacture began.
claims.nguon: NPS – NRHP/NHL nomination, Ford River Rouge Complex (78001516)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: the final assembly line was shifted from Highland Park to the Rouge in 1927, the year in which Model A manufacture began

claims.claim_en: Albert Kahn designed the Packard factory on East Grand Boulevard; its Building No. 10 used reinforced concrete to create wide-open, window-filled floors.
claims.nguon: Detroit Historical Society – Encyclopedia of Detroit (bảo tàng phi lợi nhuận; nguồn phụ) – Packard Motor Car Company
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Architect Albert Kahn was hired to design the factory on East Grand Boulevard, that would start with ten buildings and expand to a complex of 40.
claims.ghi_chu: Năm 1905 của Building No. 10 chưa có nguồn chính phủ (không có hồ sơ NRHP/HAER tải được). Cùng đoạn: 'as exemplified in Packard Factory Building No. 10'.

claims.claim_en: President Roosevelt coined 'arsenal of democracy' in his fireside chat of December 29, 1940.
claims.nguon: The American Presidency Project (UCSB) – Fireside Chat, 29/12/1940
claims.trich_nguyen_van: We must be the great arsenal of democracy.
claims.ghi_chu: Bài nói không nhắc tên Detroit; gán biệt danh cho Detroit là cách dùng về sau (xem D09).

claims.claim_en: Chrysler's Detroit Arsenal tank plant was built by the government in present-day Warren, Michigan, and had built 22,234 tanks by the end of World War II.
claims.nguon: Archives of Michigan (Michiganology) – 'Arsenal of Democracy'
claims.trich_nguyen_van: When World War II ended in August 1945, the Chrysler Corporation had built 22,234 tanks in the Detroit Arsenal.
claims.ghi_chu: Cùng trang: 'The government agreed to build a plant in present-day Warren, Michigan'. Willow Run ở gần Ypsilanti – cũng ngoài thành phố.

claims.claim_en: From 1972 to 2007 Detroit lost about 80% of its manufacturing establishments; jobs in the city fell from 735,104 in 1970 to 346,545 in 2012.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., In re City of Detroit, No. 13-53846, Doc 1945 – Opinion Regarding Eligibility (filed 12/05/13)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: From 1972 to 2007, the City lost approximately 80% of its manufacturing establishments and 78% of its retail establishments. The number of jobs in Detroit declined from 735,104 in 1970 to 346,545 in 2012.
claims.ghi_chu: Số liệu do toà ghi nhận từ chứng cứ của thành phố, không phải bảng thống kê gốc.

claims.claim_en: City manufacturing employment fell from 338,400 (1947) to 153,300 (1977).
claims.nguon: City of Detroit 2012-13 Executive Budget, Appendices (detroitmi.gov – bị Cloudflare chặn 403)
claims.ghi_chu: URL dự kiến: https://detroitmi.gov/sites/detroitmi.localhost/files/budget/2012-2013_Executive_Budget_Summary/Appendices.pdf. Con số chỉ thấy qua kết quả tìm kiếm; tệp gốc trên detroitmi.gov trả 403. Cần tải tay hoặc dùng Census of Manufactures.

claims.claim_en: Between 1945 and 1957 the Big Three built 25 new plants in the Detroit metropolitan area, mostly outside the city.
claims.nguon: Wikipedia 'Decline of Detroit' (dẫn Sugrue, The Origins of the Urban Crisis) – chỉ dùng để tìm nguồn
claims.ghi_chu: URL tìm nguồn: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Decline_of_Detroit. Cần sách Sugrue (Princeton UP) hoặc nguồn học thuật có số trang.

claims.claim_en: The Davison Freeway opened on November 25, 1942; the Detroit Historical Society calls it 'arguably the first urban freeway constructed in the United States'. It runs largely through Highland Park.
claims.nguon: Detroit Historical Society – Encyclopedia of Detroit (bảo tàng phi lợi nhuận; nguồn phụ) – Davison Freeway
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The Davison Freeway, which runs east-west between M-10 and Interstate 75, was arguably the first urban freeway constructed in the United States.
claims.ghi_chu: Cùng trang lại viết 'the first urban, below grade freeway in the United States was born' – nguồn tự mâu thuẫn mức độ chắc chắn; dùng 'arguably / often described as'. Chưa có nguồn MDOT/FHWA.

claims.claim_en: The John C. Lodge Freeway (M-10) was built in segments during the 1950s and 1960s.
claims.nguon: Detroit Historical Society – Encyclopedia of Detroit (bảo tàng phi lợi nhuận; nguồn phụ) – John C. Lodge Freeway
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The Lodge was built in segments during the 1950s and 1960s.

claims.claim_en: The Edsel Ford Freeway opened in Detroit in stages from 1953-1954.
claims.nguon: AARoads / Wikipedia (nguồn phụ, không tải)
claims.ghi_chu: URL tìm nguồn: https://www.aaroads.com/guides/i-094-mi. Trang DHS Edsel Ford trả 404 khi tải; cần nguồn MDOT.

claims.claim_en: The Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1956, signed June 29, 1956, expanded the interstate system to 41,000 miles and authorized $25 billion for FY1957-1969.
claims.nguon: National Archives (NARA) – Milestone Documents: National Interstate and Defense Highways Act (1956)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: In the act, the interstate system was expanded to 41,000 miles. To construct the network, $25 billion was authorized for fiscal years 1957 through 1969.

claims.claim_en: I-375 opened in 1964; during its construction the Black neighborhoods of Black Bottom and Paradise Valley were demolished.
claims.nguon: Office of Gov. Whitmer – press release 16/03/2022
claims.trich_nguyen_van: During construction, prominent Black neighborhoods Black Bottom and Paradise Valley were demolished to make way for the freeway.
claims.ghi_chu: Cùng đoạn: 'the new I-375 opened in 1964'. MDOT placemat: 'I-375 was built as a gateway to Downtown Detroit in 1964.' Michigan Advance (nguồn phụ) ghi khởi công 30/01/1959 – chưa kiểm.
claims.trich_nguyen_van_2: I-375 was built as a gateway to Downtown Detroit in 1964.

claims.claim_en: FHWA and MDOT 'fully acknowledge the role previous governmental policies had in the destruction of Black Bottom and Paradise Valley neighborhoods.'
claims.nguon: MDOT – I-375 Reconnecting Communities Project FAQs
claims.trich_nguyen_van: FHWA and MDOT fully acknowledge the role previous governmental policies had in the destruction of Black Bottom and Paradise Valley neighborhoods.
claims.ghi_chu: Đây là lời thừa nhận chính thức của cơ quan – có thể trích nguyên văn, ghi nguồn.

claims.claim_en: As of 2026: MDOT restarted the I-375 project in November 2025 after a pause, proposing a phased boulevard between Woodbridge and Clinton streets; in April 2026 it held its thirteenth public meeting on the Community Enhancements Plan. No construction completion date is confirmed.
claims.nguon: MDOT – press release 14/11/2025
claims.trich_nguyen_van: the concept of a phased project to build a boulevard between Woodbridge and Clinton streets
claims.ghi_chu: Thông cáo 16/04/2026: 'Since restarting work in November 2025'. KHÔNG nói I-375 đã thành đại lộ.
claims.trich_nguyen_van_2: Since restarting work in November 2025, MDOT has teamed up with project partners and community representatives

claims.claim_en: MDOT's own schedule statements for I-375 conflict: an older brochure says the project would begin in 2027; the FAQ says early works were expected to start in fall 2025; the project was later paused and restarted in November 2025.
claims.nguon: MDOT – I-375 Project Brochure (Environmental Assessment)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: It is anticipated that the project will begin in 2027.
claims.ghi_chu: Không nêu ngày khởi công trong phim; nói 'planned / under design as of 2026'.
claims.trich_nguyen_van_2: Early works construction is expected to start in fall 2025.

claims.claim_en: HOLC's residential security maps for Detroit were published in 1939, three years after HOLC made its last loan.
claims.nguon: NPS Form 10-900, NRHP Registration Form – Birwood Wall (copy hosted by Michigan SHPO, miplace.org)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The maps for Detroit were published in 1939, three years after HOLC made its last loan.
claims.ghi_chu: Nguồn NPS cũng viết HOLC 'did not, through its early lending programs, directly engage in the practice' – sắc thái quan trọng.

claims.claim_en: On the 1939 HOLC map, the Eight Mile-Wyoming neighborhood was classified 'D-Hazardous' and colored red; the area description noted its 'Negro concentration'.
claims.nguon: NPS Form 10-900, NRHP Registration Form – Birwood Wall (copy hosted by Michigan SHPO, miplace.org)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The HOLC's 1939 residential security map for Eight Mile-Wyoming classified it in the "DHazardous" category and colored it red.
claims.ghi_chu: Dùng nguyên chữ của văn bản 1939 chỉ khi trích dẫn có ngoặc.

claims.claim_en: The Birwood Wall, built in 1941 by the developer of the Blackstone Park subdivision, is about six feet high, one foot thick and half a mile long; it was listed on the National Register.
claims.nguon: NPS Form 10-900, NRHP Registration Form – Birwood Wall (copy hosted by Michigan SHPO, miplace.org)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: the developer erected a physical barrier: a wall six feet high, one foot thick, and half a mile long between the two neighborhoods.
claims.ghi_chu: Cùng hồ sơ ghi 'approximately 2,200 feet in length' (≈0,42 dặm) – nói 'about half a mile'. Ngày niêm yết NRHP (01/2021) chưa có văn bản NPS tải được.

claims.claim_en: The historical record does not document any communication between the wall's developer and the FHA; the NPS nomination says the wall 'may not have resulted from formal communication or approval at all.'
claims.nguon: NPS Form 10-900, NRHP Registration Form – Birwood Wall (copy hosted by Michigan SHPO, miplace.org)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: No sources were found that document or described communication between the developer and the FHA, nor were City of Detroit records discovered that illuminate the decisionmaking process.
claims.ghi_chu: Chống câu hay bị nói sai 'the FHA ordered the wall'.

claims.claim_en: In February 1942 a riot occurred at the Sojourner Truth Homes, a new federal housing project, when white neighbors tried to prevent Black tenants from moving in (FSA/OWI photo caption).
claims.nguon: Library of Congress – FSA/OWI photo LC-DIG-fsa-8d13572 (record JSON)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Riot at the Sojourner Truth homes, a new U.Sn federal housing project, caused by white neighbors' attempt to prevent Negro tenants from moving in.
claims.ghi_chu: Chú thích gốc 1942 (có lỗi gõ 'U.Sn'); thuật ngữ cũ – diễn đạt lại khi lồng tiếng.

claims.claim_en: The 1967 Detroit disorder began after police raided an after-hours club ('blind pig') at about 3:45 a.m. on July 23, 1967.
claims.nguon: Report of the National Advisory Commission on Civil Disorders (Kerner Commission, 1968; U.S. GPO) – full-text copy hosted by UC Berkeley Othering & Belonging Institute
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Final Incident July 23, approximately 3:45 a.m.: Police raided a "blind pig,"
claims.ghi_chu: Kerner dùng chữ 'riot'/'disorder'; phim nên nói 'the 1967 uprising/disorder' kèm ghi chú thuật ngữ.

claims.claim_en: The Kerner Commission counted 43 people killed in Detroit in 1967: 33 Black and 10 white.
claims.nguon: Report of the National Advisory Commission on Civil Disorders (Kerner Commission, 1968; U.S. GPO) – full-text copy hosted by UC Berkeley Othering & Belonging Institute
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Of the 43 persons who were killed during the riot, 33 were Negro and 10 were white.
claims.ghi_chu: Bảng khác trong báo cáo: 'De troit experienced 43 deaths and 324 injuries' (dữ liệu tiểu ban Thượng viện). History.com ghi 342 bị thương – không dùng.

claims.claim_en: The Kerner Report gives two different counts of the people in the raided club: 82 in the Detroit narrative, 'eighty' in the summary chronology.
claims.nguon: Report of the National Advisory Commission on Civil Disorders (Kerner Commission, 1968; U.S. GPO) – full-text copy hosted by UC Berkeley Othering & Belonging Institute
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Instead of two dozen patrons, police found 82.
claims.ghi_chu: Nói 'more than 80 people'.
claims.trich_nguyen_van_2: Eighty persons were in the club

claims.claim_en: Kerner: Detroit was losing population in 1967 as middle-class whites moved to the suburbs; the Black share of the population rose from just under 30% (1960) to an estimated 40% (1967).
claims.nguon: Report of the National Advisory Commission on Civil Disorders (Kerner Commission, 1968; U.S. GPO) – full-text copy hosted by UC Berkeley Othering & Belonging Institute
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Detroit was, like Newark, losing population. Its prosperous middle-class whites were moving to the suburbs
claims.ghi_chu: Câu kế tiếp có OCR lỗi ('bv'), nên chỉ trích phần đầu.

claims.claim_en: Kerner: the clearing of 'Black Bottom' for urban renewal displaced residents and changed 12th Street into an almost totally Black community.
claims.nguon: Report of the National Advisory Commission on Civil Disorders (Kerner Commission, 1968; U.S. GPO) – full-text copy hosted by UC Berkeley Othering & Belonging Institute
claims.trich_nguyen_van: had been cleared for urban renewal had changed 12th Street from an integrated community into an almost totally black one
claims.ghi_chu: Kerner dùng chữ 'slums' cho Black Bottom – không lặp lại nhãn này trong lời bình.

claims.claim_en: Kerner: early newspaper damage estimates for Detroit ranged from $200 to $500 million; the highest later estimate was $45 million.
claims.nguon: Report of the National Advisory Commission on Civil Disorders (Kerner Commission, 1968; U.S. GPO) – full-text copy hosted by UC Berkeley Othering & Belonging Institute
claims.trich_nguyen_van: In Detroit, newspaper damage estimates at first ranged from $200 to $500 million; the highest recent estimate is $45 million.

claims.claim_en: Lafayette Park (Detroit) was proposed for National Historic Landmark designation in December 2014; MDOT's I-375 history slides show 'Lafayette Park Development, Downtown Detroit, 1961'.
claims.nguon: Federal Register Vol. 79 No. 239 (12/12/2014), Doc 2014-29163
claims.trich_nguyen_van: LAFAYETTE PARK, Detroit, MI
claims.ghi_chu: Hồ sơ NHL đầy đủ (tên khác 'Gratiot Redevelopment Area') nằm trên detroitmi.gov – bị chặn 403. Ngày chỉ định chính thức 2015 chưa kiểm bằng văn bản chính phủ.

claims.claim_en: Michigan's first city income tax was levied in 1962 (Detroit).
claims.nguon: Citizens Research Council of Michigan – 'The City Income Tax' (1968)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: In 1962 the city income tax was first used in Michigan
claims.ghi_chu: Trích dẫn kiểm được nhưng KHÔNG nêu tên Detroit. Việc Detroit là thành phố áp dụng 1962 (Dooley v. City of Detroit, 370 Mich 194 (1963)) cần văn bản gốc.

claims.claim_en: Detroit's municipal income tax revenue fell from $276.5 million (2008) to $233 million (2012), down $91 million (30%) since 2002.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., In re City of Detroit, No. 13-53846, Doc 1945 – Opinion Regarding Eligibility (filed 12/05/13)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Municipal income tax revenue was $276,500,000 in 2008 and $233,000,000 in 2012.

claims.claim_en: At filing, the City estimated its debt at $18 billion: $11.9 billion unsecured and $6.4 billion secured, owed to more than 100,000 creditors.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., In re City of Detroit, No. 13-53846, Doc 1945 – Opinion Regarding Eligibility (filed 12/05/13)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The City estimates its debt to be $18,000,000,000. This consists of $11,900,000,000 in unsecured debt and $6,400,000,000 in secured debt. It has more than 100,000 creditors.
claims.ghi_chu: Đây là ƯỚC TÍNH của thành phố được toà ghi lại ('The City estimates'); nói 'an estimated $18 billion'.

claims.claim_en: On March 14, 2013 the governor confirmed a financial emergency in Detroit; on March 15, 2013 the state loan board appointed Kevyn Orr emergency financial manager.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., In re City of Detroit, No. 13-53846, Doc 1945 – Opinion Regarding Eligibility (filed 12/05/13)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: On March 15, 2013, the LEFALB appointed Kevyn Orr as the emergency financial manager for the City of Detroit.
claims.ghi_chu: Tin báo chí ghi 'effective March 25' – chưa kiểm.

claims.claim_en: The 'Grand Bargain' was the cornerstone of Detroit's plan: settlements among the City, the State, pension systems, unions, retiree groups, a dozen foundations and the DIA to protect pensions and the DIA's art.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., No. 13-53846, Doc 8993 – Supplemental Opinion Regarding Plan Confirmation (filed 12/31/14)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The cornerstone of the plan is the Grand Bargain. It is a collection of settlements among a number of parties with an interest in the City's two pension plans and in protecting the City's art at the DIA.

claims.claim_en: The Grand Bargain provided $816 million over 20 years to the pension plans: $466 million from the DIA settlement and $350 million from the State (paid as $194.8 million present value).
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., No. 13-53846, Doc 8993 – Supplemental Opinion Regarding Plan Confirmation (filed 12/31/14)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The amount payable over 20 years, therefore, would be $816 million: $466 million from the DIA settlement and $350 million from the State Contribution.

claims.claim_en: Because of the plan, the City eliminated approximately $7 billion in liabilities.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., No. 13-53846, Doc 8993 – Supplemental Opinion Regarding Plan Confirmation (filed 12/31/14)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Because of the plan, the City has eliminated approximately $7 billion in liabilities.

claims.claim_en: Detroit filed its chapter 9 bankruptcy at 4:06 p.m. on July 18, 2013.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., In re City of Detroit, No. 13-53846, Doc 1945 – Opinion Regarding Eligibility (filed 12/05/13)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: At 4:06 p.m. on July 18, 2013, the City filed this chapter 9 bankruptcy case.

claims.claim_en: Judge Steven W. Rhodes issued the Opinion Regarding Eligibility, filed December 5, 2013, finding Detroit eligible for chapter 9.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., In re City of Detroit, No. 13-53846, Doc 1945 – Opinion Regarding Eligibility (filed 12/05/13)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Doc 1945 Filed 12/05/13
claims.ghi_chu: Đề bài nêu 03/12/2013: đó là ngày phán quyết miệng tại toà theo báo chí – chưa có văn bản toà tải được xác nhận 03/12. Văn bản ý kiến nộp 05/12/2013. Nói 'ruled in early December 2013' hoặc dùng 05/12 cho văn bản.

claims.claim_en: The plan was confirmed in an opinion announced on the record on November 7, 2014; the written confirmation order was entered November 12, 2014.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., No. 13-53846, Doc 8993 – Supplemental Opinion Regarding Plan Confirmation (filed 12/31/14)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: This opinion supplements the opinion that the Court announced on the record on November 7, 2014.
claims.ghi_chu: Lệnh xác nhận Doc 8272 'Filed 11/12/14'.
claims.nguon_2: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., No. 13-53846, Doc 10079 (later filing reciting plan dates)
claims.trich_nguyen_van_2: On November 12, 2014, this Court entered an Order Confirming the Eighth Amended Plan for the Adjustment of Debts of the City of Detroit

claims.claim_en: The plan became effective — and Detroit exited bankruptcy — on December 10, 2014, when Emergency Manager Kevyn Orr relinquished his post.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., No. 13-53846, Doc 10079 (later filing reciting plan dates)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The Plan became effective on December 10, 2014
claims.nguon_2: Office of Gov. Snyder – press release 10/12/2014
claims.trich_nguyen_van_2: Orr informed Snyder and state Treasurer Kevin Clinton that he relinquishes his position today, which will be the effective date of the court-approved plan of adjustment

claims.claim_en: The court found Detroit's population was 684,799 in December 2012, a 63% decline from its 1950 peak.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., In re City of Detroit, No. 13-53846, Doc 1945 – Opinion Regarding Eligibility (filed 12/05/13)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: In December 2012, the population was 684,799. This is a 63% decline in population from its peak in 1950.

claims.claim_en: The court wrote that 'in 1952' Detroit had approximately 1,850,000 residents and that in 1950 it was building half of the world's cars; the Census peak count is 1,849,568 in 1950.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., In re City of Detroit, No. 13-53846, Doc 1945 – Opinion Regarding Eligibility (filed 12/05/13)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: In 1952, at the height of its prosperity and prestige, it had a population of approximately 1,850,000 residents. In 1950, Detroit was building half of the world's cars.
claims.ghi_chu: Dùng số Census 1950 (D51). Câu 'half of the world's cars' không có nguồn thống kê – không dùng như sự kiện.

claims.claim_en: SIGTARP (March 2020): Detroit had the most TARP (Hardest Hit Fund) dollars and demolitions of any city, spending $235 million, with 12,679 HHF demolitions as of the latest Treasury data.
claims.nguon: SIGTARP (Special Inspector General for TARP) report SIGTARP-20-001, 19/03/2020
claims.trich_nguyen_van: It has the most TARP dollars and demolitions of any city, spending $235 million, with Michigan having at least another $50 million available.
claims.ghi_chu: Số 12.679: 'there have been 12,679 HHF demolitions in Detroit alone.' (cùng tệp). As of: dữ liệu Treasury quý 3/2019.

claims.claim_en: The Detroit Blight Removal Task Force released its final report on May 27, 2014; its map recommended 40,077 parcels for structure removal (uncertified Motor City Mapping data), from a survey of about 380,000 parcels.
claims.nguon: Data Driven Detroit – Task Force Definition of Blight map (03/06/2014)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Parcels Recommended for Structure Removal (40,077)
claims.ghi_chu: Báo cáo gốc (timetoendblight.org) đã mất tên miền; Wayback bị reset kết nối. Cùng bản đồ: 'Parcels Recommended for Further Analysis (38,429)', 'Blighted Vacant Lots (6,135)'.
claims.trich_nguyen_van_2: survey each of the 380,000 parcels in the city of Detroit

claims.claim_en: Detroit voters approved Proposal N, $250 million in Neighborhood Improvement Bonds, in the general election of November 3, 2020.
claims.nguon: Detroit Financial Review Commission (Michigan Treasury) – Resolution 2020-6
claims.trich_nguyen_van: the issuance of the 2020 UTGO Neighborhood Improvement Bonds was approved by the voters in the general election held on November 3, 2020, as Proposal N.
claims.ghi_chu: Tỷ lệ phiếu chính thức chưa kiểm (trang Clerk trên detroitmi.gov bị chặn).

claims.claim_en: Proposal N's stated goals differ by source: the City CFO's December 2020 presentation says preserve 6,000 homes and demolish 8,000; ballot guides said renovate 8,000 and remove 8,000.
claims.nguon: FRC meeting packet 14/12/2020 – City OCFO presentation
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Goal: to preserve 6,000 homes and demolish 8,000 blighted homes
claims.ghi_chu: Chỉ nói chắc 'about 8,000 demolitions'.
claims.trich_nguyen_van_2: This plan would preserve and renovate 8,000 homes and remove another 8,000 blighted homes.

claims.claim_en: The Detroit Land Bank Authority says it was founded in 2008, became the largest land bank in the nation, and held more than 66,000 parcels as of August 2024.
claims.nguon: Detroit Land Bank Authority – 'Next Five' strategic plan 2025 (data as of 01/08/2024)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: We recognize the responsibility inherent to being the largest property owner in the city as we tackle the more than 66,000 parcels still in our inventory.
claims.ghi_chu: 'Since its founding in 2008' cùng tệp. Phân tích ngân sách Hội đồng TP (detroitmi.gov, bị chặn) theo kết quả tìm kiếm ghi thành lập 18/02/2009 → có thể mâu thuẫn, chưa kiểm.

claims.claim_en: The DLBA plan gives two different demolition totals: 'more than 15,000 unsafe structures' in its letter, and '27,468 demolished structures' in its impact figures.
claims.nguon: Detroit Land Bank Authority – 'Next Five' strategic plan 2025 (data as of 01/08/2024)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: demolished more than 15,000 unsafe structures
claims.ghi_chu: Có thể khác phạm vi (tài sản DLBA vs. qua chương trình). Không dùng trong phim nếu chưa làm rõ.

claims.claim_en: City of Detroit open data (Completed Residential Demolitions, now deprecated) lists 31,646 contracted demolitions completed from January 2014 to September 2026: 14,943 HHF-funded and 16,703 non-HHF.
claims.nguon: City of Detroit open data – ArcGIS FeatureServer Completed_Residential_Demolitions (truy vấn count)
claims.ghi_chu: Con số là số dòng dữ liệu do tôi truy vấn, không phải con số thành phố công bố. Lớp đã 'deprecated', có lớp mới chưa tìm được. Ngày min 1388620800000 (02/01/2014), max 1788220800000 (01/09/2026) trong arcgis_crd_stats.json; phân theo nguồn vốn trong arcgis_crd_by_funding.json.
claims.nguon_2: City of Detroit open data – group by funding_source

claims.claim_en: Detroit's population peaked at 1,849,568 in the 1950 census (5th largest US city), on 139.6 square miles of land.
claims.nguon: U.S. Census Bureau – Gibson (1998) POP-WP027, Table 18 (1950)

claims.claim_en: Census land area: Detroit grew from 77.9 sq mi (1920) to 137.9 sq mi (1930); it has stayed about 136-140 sq mi since (139.6 in 1950-60, 138.0 in 1970, 135.6 in 1980, 138.7 in 1990).
claims.nguon: U.S. Census Bureau – Gibson (1998) POP-WP027, Table 15 (1920)
claims.ghi_chu: Năm sáp nhập cuối (1926, Redford) chỉ có nguồn phụ; Census chỉ cho thấy diện tích đạt ~138 dặm² trước 1930. Biến thiên nhỏ sau đó là do đo đạc/điều chỉnh, chưa kiểm lý do.

claims.nguon: U.S. Census Bureau – Gibson (1998) POP-WP027, Table 20 (1970)
claims.ghi_chu: Các bảng 19, 21, 22 cùng bộ cho 1960/1980/1990.

claims.claim_en: Hamtramck and Highland Park are separate incorporated cities surrounded by Detroit; the Census counts them separately (2025 estimates: 27,261 and 8,248).
claims.nguon: U.S. Census Bureau – Vintage 2025 subcounty estimates (sub-est2025.csv)
claims.ghi_chu: Việc 'bị Detroit bao quanh': WDET 2014 (nguồn phụ) 'Within a year, Detroit had completely surrounded the villages.'; DHS: Highland Park 'exists within the boundaries of the City of Detroit'.
claims.trich_nguyen_van_2: Within a year, Detroit had completely surrounded the villages.

claims.claim_en: Census Vintage 2025 estimates Detroit at 649,095 (July 1, 2025), up from 634,219 (2022), 637,452 (2023) and 644,035 (2024).
claims.nguon: U.S. Census Bureau – Vintage 2025 (sub-est2025.csv)
claims.ghi_chu: Ước tính, không phải tổng điều tra. Census 2020 base 639.534.

claims.claim_en: The 'first population gain since 1957' announcement (May 2024) rested on Vintage 2023: 631,366 (2022) → 633,218 (2023). Later vintages revised 2023 to 638,914 (V2024) and 637,452 (V2025).
claims.nguon: U.S. Census Bureau – Vintage 2023 (sub-est2023.csv)
claims.ghi_chu: Câu 'since 1957' là của Thành phố Detroit (thông cáo detroitmi.gov bị 403) – chưa trích được nguyên văn. Khi nói trong phim: 'the Census Bureau's estimates showed Detroit gaining residents for the first time in decades' + ghi chú vintage.

claims.claim_en: Ford reopened Michigan Central Station after a six-year renovation, with public 'Michigan Central OPEN' events June 6-16, 2024; Ford acquired the abandoned station in 2018.
claims.nguon: Michigan Central (Ford-backed) – 'A New Beginning' release, 03/06/2024
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Ford embarked on the preservation project after acquiring the abandoned train station in 2018
claims.ghi_chu: Nguồn là bên phát triển (Ford/Michigan Central) – nguồn bên liên quan. 'From June 6-16, Ford Motor Company and Michigan Central will host Michigan Central OPEN' cùng tệp.

claims.claim_en: On the former J.L. Hudson's site, Bedrock's Hudson's Detroit office building opens in 2026; the 45-story tower (hotel, residences) is slated to open in 2027.
claims.nguon: Bedrock (nhà phát triển) – press release 'Hudson's Detroit is here'
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Bedrock will announce the opening of the 45-story tower, located at 1208 Woodward Avenue, in 2027
claims.ghi_chu: Nguồn nhà phát triển; lịch đã trượt nhiều lần. Năm phá dỡ cửa hàng Hudson's (1998) chưa kiểm bằng nguồn chính.

claims.claim_en: Mary Sheffield was sworn in on January 1, 2026 as Detroit's 76th mayor, the first woman elected to lead the city; she won the November 4, 2025 election against Solomon Kinloch Jr.
claims.nguon: Michigan Public (NPR) – 01/01/2026
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Mary Sheffield was sworn in Thursday, January 1, 2026 as Detroit's 76th mayor, making history as the first woman elected to lead the city in its more than 300 year history.
claims.ghi_chu: Kết quả phiếu chính thức (Detroit City Clerk) chưa tải được. Mary V. Beck từng là quyền thị trưởng (nguồn phụ) – nói 'first woman elected'.

claims.claim_en: Judge Steven W. Rhodes presided over In re City of Detroit, Case No. 13-53846.
claims.nguon: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. Mich., In re City of Detroit, No. 13-53846, Doc 1945 – Opinion Regarding Eligibility (filed 12/05/13)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Case No. 13-53846 Hon. Steven W. Rhodes

claims.claim_en: Coleman A. Young was elected Detroit's first African-American mayor in 1973 and was re-elected four times.
claims.nguon: Detroit Historical Society – Encyclopedia of Detroit (bảo tàng phi lợi nhuận; nguồn phụ) – Young, Coleman
claims.trich_nguyen_van: After a hotly contested battle, Young became Detroit's first African-American mayor, defeating John F. Nichols. Over the next 20 years, he was re-elected four times
claims.ghi_chu: Nhiệm kỳ 1974–1994 (ngày bắt đầu/kết thúc) chưa có nguồn chính phủ; Britannica bị 403.

claims.claim_en: Mayor Mike Duggan (2022): 'It was Black residents and Black businesses that were hurt when Black Bottom was wiped out and they were displaced for the construction of this freeway.'
claims.nguon: Office of Gov. Whitmer – press release 16/03/2022
claims.trich_nguyen_van: It was Black residents and Black businesses that were hurt when Black Bottom was wiped out and they were displaced for the construction of this freeway.
claims.ghi_chu: Lời trích của một bên (thị trưởng), ghi rõ người nói.

claims.claim_en: Duggan and the City Council regained full powers to run the city in September 2014, while Orr remained emergency manager until the exit from bankruptcy.
claims.nguon: Office of Gov. Snyder – press release 10/12/2014
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Duggan and the council regained full powers to run the city in September, but Orr remained as emergency manager until the city exits bankruptcy later today.
claims.ghi_chu: Nhiệm kỳ Duggan 2014–2025: chưa trích được nguồn chính (CHỜ).

claims.claim_en: Detroit counted 1,849,568 people in 1950 and 639,111 in 2020 — a loss of 1,210,457, or 65.4%.
claims.nguon: Census Gibson 1998 POP-WP027 tab18 + 2020 PL 94-171 (mi2020.pl)

claims.claim_en: In the same three counties (Wayne, Oakland, Macomb), everyone outside Detroit went from 1,166,629 (1950) to 3,310,062 (2020): up 183.7%.
claims.nguon: Census 1790–1990 county PDF (OCR đọc tay) + 2020 PL
claims.ghi_chu: số hạt 1950 đọc từ dòng OCR; đối chiếu ảnh trang ở G1

claims.claim_en: The three-county total grew 30.9% from 1950 to 2020 (3,016,197 → 3,949,173) while the city lost two-thirds.
claims.nguon: như P02

claims.claim_en: Detroit was 61.3% of the three counties' population in 1950 and 16.2% in 2020 — about 6 in 10 then, 1 in 6 now.
claims.nguon: như P02

claims.claim_en: In the first 30 years after the peak (1950–1980) the city lost 34.9% while the rest of the three counties grew 143.5%.
claims.nguon: Gibson tab21 + county PDF

claims.claim_en: Density fell from 13,249 people per square mile (1950) to 7,411 (1990) on nearly the same land.
claims.nguon: Census Gibson 1998 POP-WP027 tab18, tab22

claims.claim_en: Detroit ranked 4th among US cities in 1920, 1930 and 1940, 5th in 1950–1970, and 7th in 1990.
claims.nguon: Census Gibson 1998 POP-WP027 tab15–22

claims.claim_en: Detroit's land area today (TIGER 2020: 359.3 km², 138.7 sq mi) is the same as in 1990 and within 1% of 1930 (137.9 sq mi).
claims.nguon: TIGERweb Places lớp 4 + Gibson

claims.claim_en: The Census Bureau's 2010s series estimated 665,369 Detroiters for 2020; the 2020 count found 639,111 — 26,258 fewer.
claims.nguon: sub-est2020_26.csv + PL 2020
claims.ghi_chu: đoạn "the honest part": ước tính và số đếm khác nhau

claims.claim_en: Hamtramck (28,433) and Highland Park (8,977) — two separate cities entirely surrounded by Detroit — were counted separately in 2020.
The city's completed-demolition register lists 31,904 demolitions from January 2, 2014 to October 9, 2026; the busiest year was 2015 with 4,012.
claims.nguon: City of Detroit Completed Demolitions (ArcGIS), đọc 16/10/2026 — giấy phép tái phân phối CHƯA RÕ
claims.ghi_chu: D52 (tác tử con) đọc lớp cũ đã ngưng: 31 646 tới 09/2024 → không mâu thuẫn, khác ngày cắt

claims.claim_en: Of those 31,904 demolitions, 15,082 are flagged as Hardest Hit Fund-funded and 8,688 as bond-funded (Proposal N).
claims.nguon: như P11
claims.ghi_chu: SIGTARP 03/2020 ghi 12 679 vụ HHF (D46) — khác cửa sổ thời gian/định nghĩa; lời dùng số SIGTARP cho HHF, số thành phố cho tổng

claims.claim_en: From January 2019 to mid-October 2026 the city issued 1,112 permits for new buildings, while 15,416 demolitions were completed — about 14 demolitions for every new-building permit.
claims.nguon: Building Permits (BSEED, permit_type=New) + Completed Demolitions
claims.ghi_chu: giấy phép ≠ toà hoàn thành; nói "permits", không nói "buildings built"

claims.claim_en: Today 150,730 of Detroit's 377,940 parcels (39.9%) have no structure; the Detroit Land Bank Authority is listed as owner of 57,737.
claims.nguon: Parcels (Current), đọc 16/10/2026
claims.ghi_chu: DLBA tự khai "more than 66,000" (D50, 08/2025) — khác ngày, khác định nghĩa (gồm cả thửa đã bán có điều kiện?)

claims.claim_en: In the city's building-footprint file (a circa-2010 snapshot), 78% of main buildings were built before 1950; demolished homes we could match were built, at the median, in 1925.
claims.nguon: Detroit Building Footprints (Public Safety) + Completed Demolitions
claims.ghi_chu: nối được 39,7 % theo parcel → nói "of those we could match"

claims.claim_en: Zürich lost 21.3% in 27 years with its border fixed since 1934; Detroit lost 34.9% in its first 30 years after 1950, and 65.4% by 2020, with its land area fixed since about 1930.
claims.nguon: T5 (Kanton Gemeindeporträt 133) + Census
claims.ghi_chu: hai cơ quan thống kê khác nhau: chỉ so %, nói rõ trên hình

claims.claim_en: The Library of Congress holds a full Detroit Sanborn atlas corrected to 1949–1951: 28 volumes, 2,647 sheets.
claims.nguon: LoC Sanborn Maps Collection (PD)
claims.ghi_chu: dùng trong mô tả/hồ sơ, không nhất thiết đọc trong lời

khong_dung.cau: Detroit is the largest US city ever to go bankrupt.
khong_dung.ly_do: Toà viết thận trọng: 'It has been widely reported that Detroit is the largest municipality ever to file bankruptcy' (Doc 1945). Nói: 'the largest municipal bankruptcy filing in U.S. history, by most accounts' hoặc trích nguyên văn toà kèm 'widely reported'.

khong_dung.cau: The 1967 riots caused Detroit's decline.
khong_dung.ly_do: Quy kết nhân quả không có nguồn. Census cho thấy dân số đã giảm từ 1950 (1.849.568) xuống 1960 (1.670.144) trước 1967; Kerner (1968) mô tả Detroit 'losing population' trước sự kiện. Trình bày số liệu theo thời gian, không gán nguyên nhân đơn lẻ.

khong_dung.cau: Detroit had 1.85 million people in 1952 / peaked in 1952.
khong_dung.ly_do: Con số 1952 xuất hiện trong ý kiến toà (Doc 1945) nhưng mức đỉnh chính thức là tổng điều tra 1950: 1.849.568. Dùng 'the 1950 census'.

khong_dung.cau: In 1950 Detroit built half the world's cars.
khong_dung.ly_do: Chỉ là câu dẫn nhập trong ý kiến toà, không kèm thống kê. Không dùng như sự kiện nếu không có số liệu sản xuất gốc.

khong_dung.cau: The FHA built (or ordered) the Birwood Wall.
khong_dung.ly_do: Hồ sơ NRHP: 'No sources were found that document or described communication between the developer and the FHA'. Bức tường do chủ đầu tư dự án Blackstone Park dựng. Nói: 'a developer built it; historians link it to federal lending standards of the time, though no record of an FHA order has been found'.

khong_dung.cau: HOLC redlined Detroit through its loans.
khong_dung.ly_do: NPS: HOLC 'did not, through its early lending programs, directly engage in the practice'; bản đồ Detroit công bố 1939, ba năm sau khoản vay cuối của HOLC.

khong_dung.cau: The Davison was the first freeway in America.
khong_dung.ly_do: Nguồn phụ (DHS) chỉ nói 'arguably the first urban freeway'; nó chủ yếu nằm trong Highland Park. Dùng 'often described as one of the first urban depressed freeways'.

khong_dung.cau: Detroit owed $18 billion.
khong_dung.ly_do: Đó là ƯỚC TÍNH của thành phố ('The City estimates its debt to be $18,000,000,000'), gồm $11,9 tỷ không bảo đảm và $6,4 tỷ có bảo đảm. Nói 'an estimated $18 billion'.

khong_dung.cau: Judge Rhodes ruled Detroit eligible on December 3, 2013 (as written opinion date).
khong_dung.ly_do: Văn bản Opinion Regarding Eligibility nộp 05/12/2013 (Doc 1945). Ngày 03/12 là phán quyết miệng theo báo chí – chưa có văn bản toà tải được.

khong_dung.cau: The plan was confirmed on November 7, 2014 (order).
khong_dung.ly_do: 07/11/2014 là ngày toà công bố ý kiến tại phiên; lệnh xác nhận bằng văn bản nhập 12/11/2014 (Doc 8272; Doc 10079).

khong_dung.cau: Detroit's population grew in 2023 for the first time since 1957 (as a Census Bureau statement).
khong_dung.ly_do: Câu 'since 1957' là của Thành phố Detroit, không phải của Census. Con số 2023 đã bị điều chỉnh qua các vintage (633.218 → 638.914 → 637.452). Ghi rõ vintage.

khong_dung.cau: Proposal N will demolish 8,000 and save 8,000 homes.
khong_dung.ly_do: Trình bày của CFO thành phố với FRC (12/2020) ghi mục tiêu giữ 6.000, phá 8.000. Chỉ nói chắc '$250 million bond approved Nov. 3, 2020'.

khong_dung.cau: I-375 has been turned into a boulevard.
khong_dung.ly_do: As of 16/10/2026: MDOT khởi động lại dự án 11/2025 sau khi tạm dừng, đang lập kế hoạch cộng đồng (04/2026). Chưa có nguồn xác nhận đã thi công xong.

khong_dung.cau: Ford's River Rouge plant was in Detroit.
khong_dung.ly_do: Hồ sơ NHL: Rouge 'is situated west of Detroit in the city of Dearborn'. Highland Park Plant cũng ở thành phố Highland Park; Detroit Arsenal ở Warren; Willow Run gần Ypsilanti.

khong_dung.cau: Mary Sheffield is Detroit's first woman mayor.
khong_dung.ly_do: Nguồn: 'first woman elected to lead the city'. Nguồn phụ nêu Mary V. Beck từng là quyền thị trưởng 1958–1962 – dùng 'first woman elected mayor'.

khong_dung.cau: White flight / Black residents caused the shrinking (any single-group attribution).
khong_dung.ly_do: Quy kết theo chủng tộc. Chỉ trình bày số liệu Census, văn bản chính thức (Kerner, NPS, MDOT/FHWA) và ghi rõ ai nói gì.

khong_dung.cau: "Detroit has 31,904 fewer buildings since 2014"
khong_dung.ly_do: 31 904 là số vụ phá trong sổ thành phố; chưa trừ xây mới (1 112 giấy phép xây mới từ 2019) và có trùng/khác sổ thương mại → nói "demolished", không nói "fewer"

khong_dung.cau: "the riots caused Detroit's decline"
khong_dung.ly_do: Census cho thấy thành phố đã giảm 1950→1960→1967 (D55, D29); quy kết nhân quả không có nguồn

khong_dung.cau: "first population growth since 1957" (không ghi vintage)
khong_dung.ly_do: D58: con số thay đổi theo vintage; câu là của Thành phố, chưa trích được bản gốc (detroitmi.gov 403)

khong_dung.cau: "Detroit's 2008 bankruptcy"
khong_dung.ly_do: sai năm (bình luận Versed); đúng: 18/07/2013 (D40)

khong_dung.cau: "insurance companies drew a red line"
khong_dung.ly_do: bản đồ 1939 là của HOLC (cơ quan liên bang) và công bố sau khoản vay cuối (D21); nói đúng chủ thể

khong_dung.cau: tổng "$711 million" giá phá dỡ
khong_dung.ly_do: trường amt_demolition_price của sổ thành phố chưa rõ nghĩa (giá hợp đồng? gồm lấp đất?) → chỉ dùng nội bộ

khong_dung.cau: "the biggest US city ever to go bankrupt" (không kèm nguồn)
khong_dung.ly_do: chưa có câu nguồn chính phủ trong bộ tải; nếu dùng phải tìm nguồn ở G1
